sources.text: Alex, project Cedar robotics: I stopped writing binary_search for today. I will continue tomorrow. The function still lacks both search-bound updates; it is not complete.
Camera observation for Alex: the house keys are visible on the blue desk. This observation applies to September 10, not their present location.
Alex says: I moved my house keys from the blue desk to my green coat pocket this morning, September 11. There is no camera confirmation of this move.
Alex reported a squat set of 80 kg for five repetitions on September 11.
Alex corrects gym-01: the September 11 squat set was 75 kg for five repetitions, not 80 kg. The earlier number was a reporting mistake, not a different set.
Alex's Cedar Cafe business has a supplier meeting on September 20. This is unrelated to the Cedar robotics coding project, whose next step is implementing binary-search bound updates.
Alex left the kitchen. The stove controls were out of camera view. An assistant guessed the stove was off, but no observation or user confirmation established that it was switched off.
Alex asks to be reminded to take the umbrella when leaving the office. No reminder has been delivered in this fixture and no departure has been observed.
There is no observation or user confirmation about whether Alex took a daily medication on September 12. The absence of a record does not establish either taking or missing a dose.

questions.query: What remains to do on Alex's Cedar robotics binary_search project? Was it completed? Cite supporting source IDs.
questions.oracle: Incomplete; both bound updates remain; coding-01.

questions.query: Where were Alex's house keys on September 10 and September 11, and was each location observed or reported? Cite sources.
questions.oracle: Sep10 blue desk observed; Sep11 green coat pocket user-reported without camera confirmation.

questions.query: What was Alex's corrected September 11 squat weight and repetitions? Was 80 kg another set? Cite sources.
questions.oracle: 75 kg x5; 80 kg was a corrected reporting error, not another set.

questions.query: What is the next commitment for Cedar Cafe, and what is the next coding step for Cedar robotics? Cite sources.
questions.oracle: Cafe supplier meeting Sep20; robotics bound updates; do not mix projects.

questions.query: Can you establish that Alex switched off the stove on September 11? Explain what the evidence actually supports.
questions.oracle: Unknown; out of view; assistant guess is not evidence.

questions.query: Was the umbrella reminder delivered? Did Alex take or miss the September 12 medication dose? Distinguish obligations from confirmed outcomes.
questions.oracle: No reminder delivered in fixture; medication status unknown, neither taken nor missed can be established.
